name: daisy-cotton-blocks
description: Stylesheet build for daisy-cotton-blocks. The built CSS is committed, so installing the Python package needs none of this.
$comment: `build` and `test` exist under those exact names so the verify gate's node adapter finds them — it treats a step as present only when package.json declares a script of that name. `test` is the same check the Stylesheet workflow runs, so a stale committed stylesheet fails locally before a pull request is opened rather than in CI after.
